g_rules.rule: When generating search terms, expand medical abbreviations to their full clinical terms and include both the abbreviated and expanded forms in the search query to maximize recall
For anatomical structures and body parts, prefer 'body structure' hierarchy over other types when multiple candidates are available
For clinical actions and interventions, prefer 'procedure' hierarchy over 'finding' hierarchy when both are present
When the span represents a clinical state or observation, prefer 'finding' hierarchy over other types unless the context clearly indicates a disorder or procedure
Consider section context when interpreting ambiguous terms - the same abbreviation may map to different concepts in different sections

stage_1_span.label: Physical_Exam_Abbreviation
stage_1_span.description: Single or double capital letter abbreviations in Physical Exam sections representing examination systems or vital signs

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Expand examination system abbreviations to their full clinical examination terms based on standard medical nomenclature

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select concepts that represent examination procedures or vital sign findings based on the specific abbreviation context

stage_1_span.label: Medication_Allergy
stage_1_span.description: Medication names listed in the Allergies section

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for allergy concepts related to the medication class, not just the medication itself

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select allergy or hypersensitivity findings rather than the substance itself

stage_1_span.label: Clinical_Condition
stage_1_span.description: Disease names, disorders, and pathological conditions mentioned throughout the note

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search using the exact clinical term and common medical synonyms for the condition

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Prefer disorder hierarchy for pathological conditions, finding hierarchy for symptoms or observations

stage_1_span.label: Surgical_Procedure
stage_1_span.description: Surgical intervention names, operative procedures, and surgical techniques

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for the specific surgical procedure name including approach modifiers when present

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select procedure concepts that match both the intervention type and approach

stage_1_span.label: Anatomical_Structure
stage_1_span.description: Body parts, organs, and anatomical locations

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for anatomical structure terms using standard anatomical nomenclature

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select body structure concepts over procedural or finding concepts

stage_1_span.label: Clinical_Finding
stage_1_span.description: Observable clinical states, symptoms, and examination findings

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for clinical observation and finding terms, including normal and abnormal states

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select finding concepts for observable clinical states and patient conditions

stage_1_span.label: Therapy_Regime
stage_1_span.description: Treatment modalities, therapeutic interventions, and care management activities

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for therapy and regime concepts including specific treatment approaches

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select regime/therapy concepts for ongoing treatments, procedure concepts for discrete interventions

stage_1_span.label: Negated_Finding
stage_1_span.description: Clinical findings that are explicitly absent or negated

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for the positive form of the finding when the text indicates absence

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select the positive finding concept even when the clinical context indicates absence

stage_1_span.label: Activity_Status
stage_1_span.description: Descriptions of patient functional status, mobility, and activity levels

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for functional assessment and activity-related finding concepts

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select finding concepts that describe functional or activity status

stage_1_span.label: Education_Instruction
stage_1_span.description: Patient education topics, discharge instructions, and clinical recommendations

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for patient education and clinical instruction procedure concepts

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select procedure concepts related to patient education or clinical guidance

stage_1_span.label: Morphologic_Abnormality
stage_1_span.description: Structural abnormalities, lesions, and pathological morphology

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for morphological and structural abnormality concepts

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select morphologic abnormality concepts for structural pathology

stage_1_span.label: Implicit_Concept
stage_1_span.description: Terms that map to conceptually related but not literally matching SNOMED concepts

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for clinically equivalent concepts rather than literal term matches when the exact term has no SNOMED equivalent

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select concepts that represent the clinical intent even if not literally matching the text

stage_1_span.label: Multi_Word_Clinical_Phrase
stage_1_span.description: Complex clinical phrases spanning multiple words that represent a single clinical concept

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for the complete clinical phrase as a unified concept, including common clinical variations

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select concepts that capture the full semantic meaning of the multi-word phrase

stage_1_span.label: Clinical_Term_Unknown
stage_1_span.description: Clinical terms that should be annotated but have no clear SNOMED mapping

stage_2_search.intent_translation: Search for the term but be prepared for no suitable matches

stage_3_select.disambiguation_logic: Select 'Unknown' when no appropriate SNOMED concept exists for the clinical term
